cases.sql: SELECT f.airline, f.origin, SUM(b.price) AS revenue FROM flights f JOIN bookings b ON f.id = b.flight_id WHERE NOT b.is_cancelled GROUP BY CUBE(f.airline, f.origin);
cases.reply:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_flights.alias("f")
    .join(df_bookings.alias("b"), F.col("f.id") == F.col("b.flight_id"), "inner")
    .filter(~F.col("b.is_cancelled"))
    .cube(F.col("f.airline"), F.col("f.origin"))
    .agg(F.sum(F.col("b.price")).alias("revenue"))
)
```

cases.sql: SELECT id, INITCAP(LOWER(TRIM(full_name))) AS clean_name, REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(full_name), ' +', '_') AS slug FROM patients WHERE full_name IS NOT NULL;
cases.reply:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_patients
    .filter(F.col("full_name").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        F.initcap(F.lower(F.trim("full_name"))).alias("clean_name"),
        F.regexp_replace(F.trim("full_name"), " +", "_").alias("slug"),
    )
)
```

cases.reply:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

result = (
    df_appointments
    .groupBy("doctor_id", "appt_date")
    .agg(F.count("*").alias("n"))
    .withColumn("max_n", F.max("n").over(Window.partitionBy("doctor_id")))
    .filter(F.col("n") == F.col("max_n"))
    .select("doctor_id", "appt_date", "n")
```
